lines.en: On Saturday, I had lunch with my friend.
lines.zh: 星期六，我和朋友一起吃午饭。

lines.en: We went to the hawker centre.
I had noodles. The soup was delicious!
A parcel was at the door.
It was a gift from my sister.
There was a letter for me too.
I sent my sister a message.
It was a very nice day.

dialogue.title: 前台来了包裹
dialogue.setting: 中午，快递员 Ali 给 Amy 送包裹到补习中心前台，同事 Jason 也在。

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.en: Hello, I have a parcel for Amy.
lines.zh: 你好，我有一个 Amy 的包裹。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I bought a new bag online.
lines.zh: 我在网上买了一个新包。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sure! What do you want to eat?

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.zh: 我们去试试楼下的面吧。

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.en: The box is heavy. Let me carry it for you.
